🏗️ Architecture document written to `_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture.md`.

Here's the design summary:

**6 architectural decisions made:**

| # | Decision |
|---|---|
| AD-1 | Stdlib only — no `slowapi`. Fixed-window in ~30 lines. |
| AD-2 | Router-level `Depends`, not middleware — `/health` exempt automatically (it's on `app`, not a router) |
| AD-3 | Single key rule: `X-User-Id` header if present, else client IP |
| AD-4 | Fixed-window counter, one `threading.Lock` (sync handlers run in thread pool) |
| AD-5 | Fail open — unexpected counter error allows the request through |
| AD-6 | Env vars read at module import, matching `DATABASE_URL` pattern in `deps.py` |

**Files changed (exactly 4):**

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/api/rate_limit.py` | **NEW** — full implementation (~30 lines) |
| `src/api/routes/users.py` | One line: add `dependencies=[Depends(check_rate_limit)]` to `APIRouter(...)` |
| `src/api/routes/orders.py` | One line: same |
| `tests/test_rate_limit.py` | **NEW** — 8 test cases, `autouse` fixture resets `_store` between tests |

**Not touched:** `main.py`, `deps.py`, `models.py`, `pyproject.toml`.

All 6 PRD open questions are resolved in the document.

---

**Ready for next handoff.**

The developer can implement directly from §3 of the architecture doc — the full `rate_limit.py` source, the two one-line router changes, and the test fixture pattern are all spelled out.
